text.aria-label: Title text 'Primaries with MVA-only readings: label-free gate around three labelled events. Blue: measured power. Orange: the gate's weight on the forecast with lags, from the forecast issued at 09:00 each day (forecast R1, leave-one-month-out). Dashed: weight 0.5.'
text.tspan: Primaries with MVA-only readings: label-free gate around three labelled events.
Blue: measured power. Orange: the gate's weight on the forecast with lags, from the forecast
issued at 09:00 each day (forecast R1, leave-one-month-out). Dashed: weight 0.5.
